component.name: RequestingPartyGrp
component.doc: This group defines the Clearing member responsible for the risk limits.

component.name: PartyRiskLimitsUpdateGrp
component.doc: This group defines the number of limits being defined.

component.name: RiskLimitTypesGrp
component.doc: This group specifies the type of limit.

component.name: RiskInstrumentScopeGrp
component.doc: This group defines the instrument (if any) to which the limit is applied.

field.name: Account
field.doc: Account provided by the Trading Member for clearing purposes.

field.name: AvgPx
field.doc: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

field.name: ClOrdID
field.doc: Unique identifier for an order assigned by the trading member. Trading Members that submit GTD / GTC orders must ensure uniqueness across days, for example by embedding a date within the ClOrdID value.

field.name: CumQty
field.doc: Total executed order quantity (expressed in number of Lots).

field.name: Currency
field.doc: Identifies currency used for price (i.e. instrument trading currency).

field.name: ExecID
field.doc: Unique identifier of Execution Report (8) message.

field.name: ExecRefID
field.doc: Provided in case of ExecType (150) = H (Trade Cancel). ExecID (17) value of Execution Report (8) messege informing about a trade that is being cancelled.

field.name: SecurityIDSource
field.doc: Identifies class or source of the SecurityID (48) value.

field.name: LastPx
field.doc: Provided in case of ExecType (150) = F (Trade) or H (Trade Cancel). Price of last execution.

field.name: LastQty
field.doc: Provided in case of ExecType (150) = F (Trade) or H (Trade Cancel). Quantity of last execution (expressed in number of Lots).

field.name: MsgType
field.doc: Defines message type. Always third field in message.

field.name: OrderID
field.doc: Unique identifier for an order assigned by the trading system. OrderID is unique across all trading days, all order books, and all trading members, and it is persistent for the entire life of an order (i.e. it does not change after order modification). OrderID is generated for each order as a concatenation of connection ID + sequential number of a trading day (starting from 1) + sequence number of the message.

field.name: OrderQty
field.doc: Initial total order quantity (expressed in number of Lots).

field.name: OrdStatus
field.doc: Provides the current status of an order in the trading system.

field.name: OrdType
field.doc: Type of the order.

value.doc: K = Market With Left Over as Limit

field.name: OrigClOrdID
field.doc: Provided in the response to a Cancel Request or Cancel/Replace Request (ExecType (150) = 4 or 5). OrigClOrdID is the last ClOrdID in the modification chain for an order.

field.name: Price
field.doc: Conditionally required if OrdType = 2 (Limit) or 4 (Stop Limit). Price per unit of quantity (e.g. 1 Lot).

field.name: RefSeqNum
field.doc: Reference message sequence number.

field.name: SecurityID
field.doc: Security identifier value of SecurityIDSource (22) type (e.g. ISIN, exchange symbol, etc). Requires SecurityIDSource.

field.name: Side
field.doc: Side of order.

field.name: Text
field.doc: Free format text string for Trading Member use.

field.name: TimeInForce
field.doc: Specifies when the order should get expired (Day, Good Till Time, Good Till Date, Good Till Cancel), when it should be activated (At The Opening, At The Closing), or how it should be executed (Immediate Or Cancel, Fill Or Kill).

field.name: TransactTime
field.doc: Time the order submission process was initiated by the Trading Member. This time should be earlier than message SendingTime (52) provided in the header.

field.name: PositionEffect
field.doc: Indicates whether the resulting position after a trade should be an opening position or closing position. Used for omnibus accounting - where accounts are held on a gross basis instead of being netted together.

field.name: CxlRejReason
field.doc: Code to identify reason for cancel rejection.

field.name: OrdRejReason
field.doc: Provided in case of ExecType (150) = 8 (Rejected). Code to identify reason for order rejection.

field.name: TradeReportRejectReason
field.doc: Reason Trade Capture Request was rejected. 100+ reserved and available for bi-laterally agreed upon user-defined values.

field.name: QuoteID
field.doc: Unique identifier for quote.

field.name: ExpireTime
field.doc: Conditionally required if TimeInForce = 6 and ExpireDate (432) is not specified. Time of order expiration (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as GMT). It always refers to the current trading day. ExpireDate and ExpireTime tags are mutually exclusive.

field.name: BidPx
field.doc: Bid price.

field.name: OfferPx
field.doc: Offer price.

field.name: BidSize
field.doc: 0 for quote cancellation. Bid quantity (expressed in number of Lots).

field.name: OfferSize
field.doc: 0 for quote cancellation. Offer quantity (expressed in number of Lots).

field.name: ExecType
field.doc: Describes the type of Execution Report (8) message, while OrderStatus (39) provides the current status of an order in the trading system.

field.name: LeavesQty
field.doc: Quantity remaining for further execution (expressed in number of Lots). In case of an order that is no longer active, i.e. OrdStatus (39) is = 4 (Canceled), C (Expired), 8 (Rejected), LeavesQty (151) is set to 0, otherwise LeavesQty (151) = OrderQty (38) - CumQty (14).

field.name: MDEntryID
field.doc: Identifier for an order assigned by the trading system for Market Data purposes. Corresponds to the PublicOrderID field in Market Data messages. MDEntryID is unique across all order books and all trading members, but only within a single trading day. On the next trading day the numbering is reset and starts all over again (i.e. MDEntryID is not persistent for the entire life of an order). Moreover it also changes with each refill of an Iceberg order.

field.name: NoQuoteEntries
field.doc: The number of quotes for this Symbol (instrument) (QuoteSet) that follow in this message.

field.name: NoQuoteSets
field.doc: The number of sets of quotes in the message.

field.name: QuoteStatus
field.doc: Status of the mass quote acknowledgement.

field.name: QuoteEntryID
field.doc: Required if NoQuoteEntries > 0. Unique identifier for a quote. The QuoteEntryID stays with the quote as a static identifier even if the quote is updated.

field.name: QuoteSetID
field.doc: Required if NoQuoteSets > 0. Sequential number for the Quote Set. For a given QuoteID - assumed to start at 1. Must be the first field in the repeating group.

field.name: TotNoQuoteEntries
field.doc: Total number of quotes for the quote set across all messages. Should be the sum of all NoQuoteEntries in each message that has repeating quotes that are part of the same quote set.

field.name: QuoteEntryRejectReason
field.doc: Reason quote entry was rejected.

field.name: RefMsgType
field.doc: The MsgType (35) of the FIX message being referenced.

field.name: BusinessRejectReason
field.doc: Code to identify reason for a Business Message Reject message.

value.doc: Throttle limit exceeded, session will be disconnected
NoPartyIDs (453) must be equal to 2 or 3

field.name: ExpireDate
field.doc: Conditionally required if TimeInForce = 6 and ExpireTime (126) is not specified. Date of order expiration (last day the order can trade), always expressed in terms of the local market date. ExpireDate and ExpireTime tags are mutually exclusive.

field.name: CxlRejResponseTo
field.doc: Identifies the type of request that a Cancel Reject is in response to.

field.name: PartyIDSource
field.doc: Used to identify classification source.

value.doc: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) for exchange member clients.
Short code identifier for non-exchange-member clients.

field.name: PartyID
field.doc: Identification of the party. The short code representing the client, execution decision maker or investment decision maker represented by this block (depending on the PartyRole value).

field.name: PartyRole
field.doc: Identifies the type of PartyID (448). Specifies the role represented by the short code provided in the PartyID tag.

field.name: NoPartyIDs
field.doc: Number of repetitions of PartyID (448), PartyIDSource (447), PartyRole (452), PartyRoleQualifier (2376) groupings.

field.name: TradeReportTransType
field.doc: Identifies Trade Report message transaction type.

field.name: OrderCapacity
field.doc: Designates the capacity of the firm placing the order.

field.name: OrderRestrictions
field.doc: Designation required for regular Liquidity Providers (as opposite to Issuer Liquidity Providers). In case of Issuer Liquidity Provider orders tag will not be provided.

value.doc: Acting as Market Maker or Specialist in the security

field.name: NoSides
field.doc: Number of Side repeating group instances.

field.name: TradeReportID
field.doc: Unique identifier of trade capture report.

field.name: TradeReportRefID
field.doc: Reference identifier used with Cancel and Replace transaction types. The TradeReportID (571) that is being referenced for trade correction or cancelation.

field.name: MatchStatus
field.doc: Provided only in outgoing messages informing about new trade or trade busting. The status of this trade with respect to matching or comparison.

field.name: AccountType
field.doc: Type of account associated with the order.

value.doc: Account is carried on customer side of the books

field.name: PriorityIndicator
field.doc: Required if Cancel/Replace accepted.

value.doc: Lost priority as a result of order change

field.name: PriceImprovement
field.doc: Amount of price improvement.

field.name: PriceDelta
field.doc: The rate of change in the price of a derivative with respect to the movement in the price of the underlying instrument(s) upon which the derivative instrument price is based.

field.name: TrdType
field.doc: Type of trade.

field.name: LastLiquidityInd
field.doc: Provided in case of ExecType (150) = F (Trade). Indicates whether the order added liquidity or removed liquidity from the order book (looking from the perspective of the current execution).

field.name: TradeReportType
field.doc: Type of Trade Report.

field.name: TrdMatchID
field.doc: Provided in case of trades (ExecType (150) = F or H). Identifier assigned to a trade by a matching system.

field.name: TrdRptStatus
field.doc: Status of trade report.

field.name: TradeID
field.doc: The unique ID assigned to the trade entity once it is received or matched by the exchange or central counterparty.

field.name: TriggerPrice
field.doc: Provided in case of OrdType (40) = 3 (Stop Loss) or 4 (Stop Limit). The price at which the order is activated and inserted into the order book.

field.name: TradeHandlingInstr
field.doc: Specified how the TradeCaptureReport (35=AE) should be handled by the respondent.

field.name: DisplayQty
field.doc: Currently displayed quantity for Iceberg order in Market Data public order order book (as opposed to initially displayed quantity).

field.name: QuoteEntryStatus
field.doc: Identifies the status of an individual quote. See also QuoteStatus (297) which is used for single Quotes.

field.name: TotNoCxldQuotes
field.doc: Total number of quotes canceled for the quote set across all messages.

field.name: TotNoAccQuotes
field.doc: Total number of quotes accepted for the quote set across all messages.

field.name: TotNoRejQuotes
field.doc: Total number of quotes rejected for the quote set across all messages.

field.name: Volatility
field.doc: Annualized volatility for option model calculations.

field.name: TimeToExpiration
field.doc: Time to expiration in years calculated as the number of days remaining to expiration divided by 365 days per year.

field.name: RiskFreeRate
field.doc: Interest rate. Usually some form of short term rate.

field.name: MarketSegmentID
field.doc: Identifies the market segment.

field.name: MarketID
field.doc: Identifies the market.

field.name: RejectText
field.doc: Provided in case of ExecType (150) = 8 (Rejected). Text description of rejction code provided in OrdRejReason (103) tag.

field.name: PassiveOnly
field.doc: Designation to allow Trading Member to specify that the order should rest in the order book prior to execution.

value.doc: 1 = Only accept order if it will not match with contra orders upon entry. Otherwise reject order.

field.name: OrderOrigination
field.doc: Designation required for orders submitted via Direct Electronic Access (both DMA or Sponsored Access). In case of regular trading access this tag should be omitted.

value.doc: 5 = Order received from a direct access or sponsored access customer

field.name: Triggered
field.doc: Indicates whether an order has been already triggered or not yet. In case of triggered VFA/VFC orders value 1, and in case of triggered Stop orders value 2.

field.name: PartyRoleQualifier
field.doc: Provides further qualification of the PartyRole (452) value.

value.doc: None (only valid for reserved short codes or in case of Clearing Firm)
Firm or legal entity (LEI) (applicable to PartyRole value 3)

field.name: ExecTypeReason
field.doc: Provided in case of ExecType (150) = 4 (Cancelled) or D (Restated) or F (Trade). Provides detailed information on ExecType (150) in case of order restatement, Iceberg order refill, unsolicited order cancellation, first trade resulting from aggressive order matching.

field.name: NoOrderAttributes
field.doc: Number of order attribute entries.

field.name: OrderAttributeType
field.doc: The type of order attribute.

field.name: OrderAttributeValue
field.doc: The value associated with the order attribute type specified in OrderAttributeType (2594). As opposite to OrderRestriction tag specifies whether the order poses any type of liquidity provision acticity (either regular or issuer).

field.name: AlgorithmicTradeIndicator
field.doc: Provided in case of ExecType (150) = F (Trade) or H (Trade Cancel). Indicates that the trade originates from a computer program or algorithm requiring little-to-no human intervention. In the context of ESMA MiFID II, a trade has to be flagged as algorithmic if at least one of the matched orders was submitted by a trading algorithm.

field.name: InitialDisplayQty
field.doc: Initially display quantity requested for Iceberg order in New Order Single (D) or Order Cancel/Replace Request (G) messages.

field.name: BidQuoteID
field.doc: Note that either BidQuoteID, OfferQuoteID or both must be specified. Marketplace assigned quote identifier for the bid side. Can be used to indicate priority.

field.name: OfferQuoteID
field.doc: Note that either BidQuoteID, OfferQuoteID or both must be specified. Marketplace assigned quote identifier for the offer side. Can be used to indicate priority.
